segments.text: V. 25. And even agonizing will not avail, after the Door is ſhut. Agonize therefore now by Faith, Prayer, Holineſs, Patience. And ye begin to ſtand without—Till then, they had not thought of it! O how new will that Senſe of their Miſery be? How late? How laſting? I know not whence ye are—I know not, that is, I approve not of your Ways.
